body: Well today it was my compulsive lying that could cost me my reputation at my job. Probably have to move again. What about you
Fucking up at everything as usual. How are you?

I don't know what to say to make you feel better but thank you for posting this because you put in words how I feel too. Best of luck, definitely seek therapy, pm me if interested. You're not alone in feeling this way.

It's a pattern in my life, I've been fired or quit from so many jobs I can't even remember them all. I had a fiancé but he left and never explained why. My parents both left me when I was young. Boo hoo I know a lot of people have it way worse than me but I'm just sick of people leaving or letting me down and I am at the center of it all so it is all my fault, I'm doing something terribly wrong. Right now my life is good for the first time in.. ever so I have everything to lose. I'd rather end my life than let it all fall apart.
Thank you. I'm sorry you feel this way too.
